name: persistence-self-monitoring
description: Persist-or-quit self-check for coding agents. Bundles the persistence-self-monitoring skill (the 'what': name the hypothesis held, count the variants, name a rival, decide) with per-host hooks (the 'when') that count what an agent cannot feel - the same file edited N times, the same command or error failing N times, tool calls piling up since the user's last message - and speak only when a threshold is crossed. Never blocks. Codex: the same hooks/ adapter as Claude Code - same events, same payload, same output envelope; the hooks run once you trust them with /hooks.
